newsitem.title: USA: Versace ashes to be flown to Italy Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Versace ashes to be flown to Italy Thursday.

text.p: The ashes of slain Italian fashion designer Gianni Versace will be taken home by members of his family on Thursday, a funeral home source said.
"He has been cremated and his ashes have been released to the family," the source said. "They are taking a private plane from Miami this morning."

The source, who declined to be identified, said Versace's body had been taken from the Riverside-Gordon Memorial Chapel in North Miami Beach and cremated in Fort Lauderdale, just north of Miami, late Wednesday or in the early hours of Thursday.
Versace was shot and killed on Tuesday by a lone gunman outside his mansion in Miami Beach. Police are hunting alleged serial killer Andrew Cunanan in connection with the killing.
Versace's sister Donatella and brother Santo were seen at the mansion on Wednesday. It was not immediately clear if they would travel back to Italy with the ashes.
A memorial service organised by the Italy-America Chamber of Commerce and city authorities was scheduled to be held on Friday at St. Patrick's Roman Catholic Church.
